The eight LibreOffice corpus workbooks are verbatim public test fixtures from
LibreOffice/core/sc/qa/unit/data/xlsx. The manifest pins each Git blob and SHA-256.
LibreOffice source licensing: https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/licenses/
These LibreOffice fixtures remain under MPL 2.0. See MPL-2.0.txt.
MPL 2.0 source license: https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/

The Google Sheets workbook is a verbatim XLSX export of the public Class Data
sample linked by Google's Sheets API Quickstart. It is parser test data, not
customer data. The manifest records the export URL, documentation and SHA-256.
Google sample attribution: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/quickstart/python
Google Developers site terms: https://developers.google.com/terms/site-policies

No network request is needed to run these tests. These fixtures establish only
the listed producer cases. They do not establish compatibility with every valid
workbook or every exporter.
